name: Nothing But Flowers
source:
Omegafication. Sexual gratification through acting out a scenario in which an alpha is treated like– or made to “regress” into– an omega. A form of humiliation play. A furtive fantasy. 

An omega cannot become a beta. A beta cannot become an alpha.
[b]An alpha can never become an omega. [/b]

[From [url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/nothing-but-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
